title: 第六章 你对我们小姐做了什么第七章 你被人甩过
content_zh:
该做的都做了，赵雅要让眼前这家伙出丑！
心中一动，一个记录玉晶出现在衣袖之中。
记录玉晶，能够记录周围的影像和声音，她打算将对方的“罪证”留下！然后出去宣扬的时候，才能百口莫辩。
“到时候就看你怎么出丑？和陆寻老师比，做梦的吧！”
想到记录玉晶很快就能拿到对方的“罪证”，自己也能好好教训对方一顿出气，赵雅眼睛闪烁，差点没忍住笑出来，正在憋着高兴，想要听听对方怎么胡说八道，就看到一双明亮的双眼，灯笼一般的停在跟前。
“啊……”
赵雅吓了一跳，连忙后退一步，这才看清正是张悬老师，气的一咬牙：“你要干什么？”
“放心，我只是看看！”张悬双手背在身后，沿着赵雅转了一圈，摇了摇头，突然停在赵雅面前，距离她不到一尺。
感受到对方身上的热量火辣辣的传来，赵雅脸色泛红，从小到大，还从未有一个男人距离她这么近，心中正在紧张，不知如何，就听到对方慢悠悠的声音响了起来：“你有病！”
听到这话，赵雅差点没直接炸开，当场昏过去：“你才有病，你全家都有病……”
她都快疯了。
这家伙脑子有问题吧，自己打出武技，让他指出缺点，这家伙却直接说自己有病，世界上怎么会有这么可恶的人！
“你怎么骂人？”张悬眉头一皱，随即明白刚才的话有些歧义，微微一笑：“我说的是你身体有病，并非骂你！”
“我没病！”赵雅冷哼：“我看你才有病！是脑子有病吧！”
她强状如牛，一拳能打出超过一百公斤的力量，有没有病，自己心里清楚的很。
“你先别忙拒绝，你是不是经常感到膻中、巨阙两处穴道隐隐作痛，尤其是月圆之夜，湿风一起，全身泛红，心烦气躁，而且还有种……”说到这张悬犹豫了一下，似乎无法用言语表达，只好道：“无论如何修炼都无法静心？”
“你……怎么知道？”
本来怒气冲冲的赵雅，本打算对方说什么，都直接否决，谁知听到这话，脸色一红，立刻呆住。
不是他说的不对，而是……太对了！
最近修炼，她每天都能感到膻中、巨阙两处穴道隐隐作疼，当然，这种疼痛并不大，对她来说忍忍就过去了，关键是……每到月圆之夜，凉风一吹，身体就会产生异样，生出一种强烈的渴望，全身泛红，情难自已，恨不得有个男人抱住……

她只是个十六、七岁未经人事的小姑娘，哪里知道这是什么，只感到羞涩无比，本以为忍忍就过去了，谁知越演越烈，伴随身体逐渐发育，胸前越来越饱满，竟然有种越来越凶的趋势。
以前运两遍功就扛过去了，而现在，十遍八遍都不管用，只好不停修炼，直到天明。
这件事，因为太过蹊跷，她谁都没敢说，就连身边最好的朋友，城主父亲，都完全不知道！
人人都不知道……这家伙怎么知道的？
她也正因为越来越熬不住，这才来学院学习，想要找出根由，彻底解决。
“我是老师，你刚才打了一套拳，就看出来了！”张悬淡淡道。
凭借拳法当然看不出这些，天道图书馆就不一样了，只要她身上有缺陷，哪怕不是功法，都能记录在内。
正因为看到了她的问题，张悬这才面容古怪。
“可有……解决方法？”
赵雅脸色泛红，咬牙道。
刚才还气势汹汹想要揭穿对方，结果对方一口说出她现在的问题，让她反而不好意思了。
“解决方法是有，明天过来上课，我会为你讲解！”
张悬摆了摆手。
“真的？”
赵雅眼睛一亮，不敢相信。
她的身体，她非常清楚，正因为快控制不住了，这才脾气暴躁，做任何事情都有些焦急，本以为这件事只能压在心底，没办法解决，做梦都没想到，眼前这个全校师资倒数第一的老师，一语道破！
而且……还有办法治疗！
“不信的话，你可以去找学院其他老师！”张悬一甩手，神色淡然，一副高人模样。
“不，不……就老师你了！”赵雅连忙点头。
她难受不是一天两天了，城内无数医者都没看出来，甚至连她爹爹，赵城主也也没发觉异常，这位张悬老师只看了一眼，就直接确认，单凭眼力，就是她之前见过这么多人无法比拟的！

正因为如此，她觉得对方肯定有办法医治。
“那块记录晶石，你还打算留着？”
张悬手指一指。
content_en:
Everything that needs to be done is done, Zhao Ya is going to make this guy in front of her look embarrassed!
With a thought in his heart, a recording jade crystal appeared in his sleeve.
Recording Jade Crystal can record the surrounding images and sounds. She plans to keep the other party's "evidence"! Then when you go out to preach, you will be able to make no excuses.
"We'll see how you make a fool of yourself then. Compared with Teacher Lu Xun, you're just dreaming!"
Thinking that Record Yujing would soon get the other party's "criminal evidence" and that she could teach the other party a lesson, Zhao Ya's eyes flickered and she almost couldn't help laughing. She was holding back her joy and wanted to hear what the other party was talking about, when she saw a pair of bright eyes, like lanterns, stopping in front of her.
"Ah..."
Zhao Ya was startled and quickly took a step back. Then she saw that it was Teacher Zhang Xuan and gritted her teeth angrily: "What are you going to do?"
"Don't worry, I'm just taking a look!" Zhang Xuan put his hands behind his back, walked around Zhao Ya, shook his head, and suddenly stopped in front of Zhao Ya, less than a foot away from her.
Feeling the heat coming from the other person's body, Zhao Ya's face turned red. She has never had a man so close to her since she was a child. She was feeling nervous. She didn't know why, but she heard the other person's slow voice: "You are sick!"
Hearing this, Zhao Ya almost exploded and fainted on the spot: "You are the only one who is sick, your whole family is sick..."
She was going crazy.
There must be something wrong with this guy's brain. He showed off his martial arts skills and asked him to point out his shortcomings, but this guy directly said that he was sick. How could there be such a hateful person in the world!
"Why are you scolding people?" Zhang Xuan frowned, then realized that there was some ambiguity in what he just said, and smiled slightly: "I said you are sick, not scolding you!"
"I'm not sick!" Zhao Ya snorted coldly: "I think you are the only one who is sick! There must be something wrong with your brain!"
She is as strong as an ox and can punch over a hundred kilograms of force with one punch. She knows very well whether she is sick or not.
"Don't refuse. Do you often feel a dull pain in the Tanzhong and Juque acupuncture points, especially on full moon nights, when there is dampness and wind, your whole body is red, you are upset and irritable, and there is also a kind of..." Zhang Xuan hesitated when talking about it, as if he couldn't express it in words, so he had to say: "No matter how you practice, you can't meditate?"
"How...how do you know?"
Zhao Ya, who was originally angry, planned to reject everything the other party said, but when she heard this, her face turned red and she immediately froze.
It's not that what he said is wrong, but...it's so right!
During her recent practice, she could feel a dull pain in her Tanzhong and Juque acupoints every day. Of course, the pain was not serious, and it would pass for her if she endured it. The key was... every full moon night, when the cool breeze blew, her body would feel strange, giving rise to a strong desire, her whole body would turn red, and she would be overwhelmed with emotion. She wished she had a man to hold her...
She was just a sixteen or seventeen-year-old girl who had never experienced anything. She didn't know what it was. She just felt extremely shy. She thought it would be over if she tolerated it, but she didn't know that it became more and more intense. As her body gradually developed, her chest became fuller and fuller, and there was a trend of becoming more and more fierce.
In the past, I could get over it by practicing the kung fu twice, but now, it didn't work ten or eight times, so I had to keep practicing until dawn.
This matter was so strange that no one dared to tell her about it. Even her best friend, the father of the city lord, had no idea!
Everyone doesn’t know…how does this guy know?
It was precisely because she couldn't bear it anymore that she came to the academy to study, hoping to find out the root cause and solve it completely.
"I'm a teacher, you just did a set of punches, you can see it!" Zhang Xuan said calmly.
Of course you can't see this with her boxing skills, but the Tiandao Library is different. As long as she has flaws, even if they are not martial arts, they can be recorded.
It was precisely because he saw her question that Zhang Xuan looked strange.
"Is there... a solution?"
Zhao Ya's face turned paleHong said through gritted teeth.
Just now she was aggressive and wanted to expose the other party, but the other party told her current problem, which made her feel embarrassed.
"There is a solution. Come to class tomorrow and I will explain it to you!"
Zhang Xuan waved his hand.
"Really?"
Zhao Ya's eyes lit up and she couldn't believe it.
She knew her body very well. Because she could no longer control it, she had a bad temper and was a little anxious about everything. She thought that this matter could only be suppressed in her heart and there was no way to solve it. She never thought that in front of her, the teacher who was the last teacher in the school would make it clear!
And... there is a way to treat it!
"If you don't believe me, you can go find other teachers in the academy!" Zhang Xuan waved his hand, looking indifferent and looking like a master.
"No, no...it's just you, teacher!" Zhao Ya nodded quickly.
She had been feeling uncomfortable for more than a day or two, and countless doctors in the city didn't notice it. Even her father and City Master Zhao didn't notice anything unusual. Teacher Zhang Xuan only took one look and confirmed directly that her eyesight alone was unmatched by the many people she had seen before!
Because of this, she felt that the other party must have a way to cure it.
"Do you still plan to keep that recording crystal?"
Zhang Xuan pointed his finger.
